Account overview: Verdant Pioneer Analytics — quantitative asset management platform based in Dublin, EU. Heavy PII and transaction data; must remain in EU. They are platform team + ML infra evaluating Private VPC to host inference.

Key concerns surfaced in pre-RFQ: strict data residency, customer-managed KMS (BYOK), detailed audit logging for model inputs/outputs for 3+ years, SOC2+ISO27001 evidence, and vendor risk questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ) responses with network diagrams.

Security questionnaire specifics / vendor intake items:
- BYOK: require HSM-backed KMS integration (AWS KMS with external key material) and explicit key rotation policy. Customer expects dual-control key escrow.
- Audit logging: immutable, append-only logs for inference requests and admin actions, retention 3 years, exportable to customer's SIEM via private endpoint.
- Data residency: inference and KV cache must stay in eu-west-1; no backups or debug dumps allowed outside EU.
- Shared responsibility: Redwood must attest to control plane separation; customer will manage prompt/data classification, encryption keys, and network ACLs. Need an explicit shared responsibility matrix for legal.
- SIG/CAIQ: request full CAIQ export and Redwoods' SOC2 Type II report plus penetration test summary and remediation timeline. Also ask for third-party subprocessor list.
- Network: enforce private endpoints + optional on-prem connector for secure model performance telemetry; require TLS1.3 and mTLS for all service endpoints.
